accepted_scope: ID-01 user-image exterior correction / ESP32-S3 functional baseline; design, compilable firmware and host verification; no physical prototype

requirements.requirement: Native editable FreeCAD enclosure, caps, internal supports, PCB mounts, battery restraint, USB support, microphone duct, LED guide, LRA seat, power/reset access, strap anchors and fasteners
requirements.acceptance: Save/reopen, valid solids, measured dimensions, assembly and motion clearances, export readback

requirements.requirement: Match latest user ID-01 image by visual proportions, as explicitly selected by user; retain 116 mm nominal height and report actual dimensions, left drawing key and hanging index trigger.
requirements.acceptance: Native save/reopen and dimensions readback, six-view reference comparison, visible feature review; source perspective/annotation inconsistencies listed separately.

requirements.requirement: Shared ECAD/MCAD board outlines, holes and orientation
requirements.acceptance: At least three noncollinear fiducial points, thickness and connector opening alignment

requirements.requirement: Complete native KiCad schematics and routed PCB set with actual symbols/footprints
requirements.acceptance: Datasheet pin review, ERC, DRC including schematic parity and unrouted connections; no silent exclusions

requirements.requirement: BQ24074 PowerPath, TPS63802 3V3, protected 1S battery and NTC, USB sink limits and ESD
requirements.acceptance: Reviewed netlist and component calculations; fabrication outputs consistent with source

requirements.requirement: S3 external antenna, IMU SPI, switched PDM mic, four buttons, RGB, DRV2605L LRA, MAX17048, EN reset, recovery pads
requirements.acceptance: BOM, footprint pin mapping, shared pin-definition validation

requirements.requirement: ESP-IDF firmware for S3 N16R8 with fault handling
requirements.acceptance: Build real ELF/BIN with pinned SDK and dependencies; record source hashes

requirements.requirement: Ordinary HID L/R; negotiated special-mode ownership; lease timeout; no duplicate/stuck buttons or replay after reconnect
requirements.acceptance: Native core behavioral tests and host integration with same firmware core

requirements.requirement: USB HID + UAC + control, BLE HID + custom GATT, Wi-Fi voice transport
requirements.acceptance: Compile transports, validate descriptors/protocol in host tests; physical enumeration/radio separately pending

requirements.requirement: IMU relative pointing and recenter; PDM capture/decimation; battery, LEDs, calibrated haptic controls
requirements.acceptance: Driver build and deterministic numerical/behavior tests; real sensing/calibration pending

requirements.requirement: Mic off by default; trigger hold and host grant; drawing/voice/haptic exclusion; fail closed on timeout/disconnect
requirements.acceptance: Adversarial transitions, held keys, boot, stale commands and cancellation tests

requirements.requirement: Host radial menu, annotation, scroll, paging, zoom, pan, locked context, editable transcription, comparison and undo
requirements.acceptance: Executable computer-side flow, integration tests; distinguish fixtures from real devices/services

requirements.requirement: Confirm before sending and independently before applying; real execution receipt before success feedback
requirements.acceptance: Negative tests plus one real local file-edit transaction with rollback

requirements.requirement: Physical RF, audio quality, endurance, drift, charge/thermal, battery fit, durability and ergonomics
